page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8ae.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores of the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz, with one thread per core. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 25%. Text processing performance is particularly notable, ranking in the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-core performance, memory bandwidth, and cryptographic operations fall within the average range. For instance, the system achieves an average multi-core stress-ng score of 24930.74 and a Redis SET throughput of 22.47 million operations per second.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.r8ae.4xlarge is the complete absence of local NVMe storage and GPU hardware, which limits its suitability for local-storage-heavy databases or machine learning acceleration. However, its high memory density and strong single-thread performance make it a cost-efficient choice for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local disk caching. It is highly suitable for in-memory databases like Redis, enterprise applications, text processing pipelines, and general-purpose memory-heavy workloads.
